import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int LIMIT = 33; // enough since N = k+1 <= 33

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] a;
        int n; // actual size

        Matrix(int size) {
            n = size;
            a = new int[n][n];
        }

        // identity matrix
        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix m = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) m.a[i][i] = 1;
            return m;
        }
    }

    static Matrix multiply(Matrix A, Matrix B) {
        int n = A.n;
        long[][] tmp = new long[n][n];
        final long LIM = 8000000000000000000L;
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (A.a[i][k] == 0) continue;
                long aik = A.a[i][k];
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    tmp[i][j] += aik * B.a[k][j];
                    if (tmp[i][j] >= LIM) tmp[i][j] %= MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        Matrix C = new Matrix(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                C.a[i][j] = (int)(tmp[i][j] % MOD);
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static Matrix shift(Matrix X, int d) {
        int n = X.n;
        int K = n - 1;
        Matrix Y = new Matrix(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int ni = (i == K) ? K : (i + d) % K;
                int nj = (j == K) ? K : (j + d) % K;
                Y.a[ni][nj] = X.a[i][j];
            }
        }
        return Y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int N = k + 1;

        // compute digits in base k
        ArrayList<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
        long temp = n;
        while (temp > 0) {
            digits.add((int)(temp % k));
            temp /= k;
        }

        int dsize = digits.size();
        ArrayList<Matrix> pw = new ArrayList<>(dsize + 1);
        // pw[0]
        Matrix base = new Matrix(N);
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
            base.a[0][j] = 1;
            base.a[j][j] = 1;
        }
        pw.add(base);

        // compute powers recursively
        for (int i = 1; i < dsize; i++) {
            Matrix cur = Matrix.identity(N);
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                cur = multiply(cur, shift(pw.get(i - 1), j));
            }
            pw.add(cur);
        }

        Matrix ans = Matrix.identity(N);
        int add = 0;
        for (int i = dsize - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int digit = digits.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < digit; j++) {
                ans = multiply(ans, shift(pw.get(i), (j + add) % k));
            }
            add = (add + digit) % k;
        }

        int ret = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            ret += ans.a[i][k];
            if (ret >= MOD) ret -= MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ret);
        sc.close();
    }
}
